notes: Oracle Database 23ai Free (slim image: no Oracle Text, so full-text search falls back to LIKE) in FREEPDB1 (user lab). Free edition caps: 2 CPU threads, 2 GB SGA/PGA, 12 GB data. Data Guard (physical standby) is not available in Free, so no replica in this stack.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR2(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR2(2) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  parent_id NUMBER(10),
  name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  depth NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  category_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR2(150) NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR2(4000) NOT NULL,
  price NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  customer_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR2(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  total_amount NUMBER(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR2(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  order_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  product_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  unit_price NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id NUMBER(19) NOT NULL,
  customer_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  payload JSON,
  value_num NUMBER(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)

datapump.notes: Data Pump schema export through a directory object on the shared volume, imported into another schema (REMAP_SCHEMA)

steps.name: directory object
expdp SCHEMAS=lab
steps.cmd: __o=$(mktemp); ( expdp system/rootpass@localhost/FREEPDB1 SCHEMAS=lab DIRECTORY=rdlab_bk DUMPFILE=lab.dmp LOGFILE=exp.log REUSE_DUMPFILES=YES ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 4 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
steps.out:
Dump file set for SYSTEM.SYS_EXPORT_SCHEMA_01 is:
  /backups/lab.dmp
Job "SYSTEM"."SYS_EXPORT_SCHEMA_01" successfully completed at Mon Sep 14 10:12:23 2026 elapsed 0 00:01:16

steps.name: create restore user
impdp REMAP_SCHEMA
steps.cmd: __o=$(mktemp); ( impdp system/rootpass@localhost/FREEPDB1 SCHEMAS=lab REMAP_SCHEMA=lab:lab_restore DIRECTORY=rdlab_bk DUMPFILE=lab.dmp LOGFILE=imp.log TABLE_EXISTS_ACTION=REPLACE ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 4 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc

steps.name: drop restore user
steps.cmd:
cat <<'SQL' | sqlplus -s / as sysdba
SET HEADING OFF FEEDBACK OFF PAGESIZE 0 LINESIZE 300 TRIMSPOOL ON
WHENEVER SQLERROR EXIT SQL.SQLCODE
ALTER SESSION SET CONTAINER = FREEPDB1;
DROP USER lab_restore CASCADE;
EXIT
SQL

rman.notes: RMAN binary is not part of gvenzl/oracle-free:*-slim*; with the full image: `ALTER DATABASE ARCHIVELOG` (mount), `RMAN> CONFIGURE CONTROLFILE AUTOBACKUP ON; BACKUP AS COMPRESSED BACKUPSET DATABASE PLUS ARCHIVELOG;` and `RECOVER DATABASE UNTIL TIME` for PITR

steps.name: log mode
steps.cmd:
cat <<'SQL' | sqlplus -s / as sysdba
SET HEADING OFF FEEDBACK OFF PAGESIZE 0 LINESIZE 300 TRIMSPOOL ON
WHENEVER SQLERROR EXIT SQL.SQLCODE
SELECT log_mode FROM v$database;
EXIT
SQL
